title: Confine Tauri bearer initialization to backend origin
summary: Deny cross-origin WebView navigation and guard token initialization by exact backend origin and top-frame context for both native windows.
reason: Remediate P2 AUDIT-FIND-W09-006. Tauri initialization scripts run on later navigations and Windows subframes, so unconditional token assignment could expose the bearer credential outside the validated backend document.
behavior_before: Both windows attached a token-bearing initialization script for their full WebView lifetime without on_navigation or a window.location origin check.
behavior_after: Both windows deny navigation outside the exact normalized backend origin, and initialization returns before assigning or retaining the token global unless it is executing in the top frame at that exact origin.
tests_added: Exact-origin Rust tests cover localhost, IPv4, IPv6, sibling ports, foreign hosts, schemes, and credentials.
Initialization-script tests require top-frame and exact-origin checks before the token global assignment and cleanup on denial.
A debug-only native probe attempts denied navigation in both the main and Pipeline Log windows and records content-free denial evidence under the system temp root.
manual_validation: AUDIT-FIND-W09-006 reproduced from current bytes: both Tauri windows previously installed the bearer initialization script without an exact-origin navigation guard or top-frame/origin gate before assignment.
